Remark 5.1 extends the construction from reversible to stationary chains.

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For rational row-stochastic A (n by n), t>=1, and X=(x_i) in Q^(n by m), the deterministic algorithm computes G=((t+1)I-tA)^(-1) and y_i=E med(x_J1,x_J2,x_J3) exactly over Q for independent samples from row G_i. Sorted threshold cuts use at most n-1 levels per feature and the implementation runs in O(n^3+mn^2+mn log n) rational operations with polynomial output bit height. For rational stationary pi, the family-332 cotype inequality with candidate constant 3024 holds for this output conditional on the release proof.
claims.status: formula derived from source; reference implementation and exact finite differential tests passed; universal guarantee conditional on release theorem
claims.novelty_boundary: Family 332 Remark 5.3 already states the expected-median representation. This lane contributes an exact finite-rational constructor/cost analysis, not a novelty claim; unpublished MN26 implementation comparison is impossible at this point.
claims.costs: Requires explicit A and rational n-by-m data; a sampler alternative costs three geometric walks (3t expected transition queries per state) but outputs a sample rather than the exact mean. No global extension selector for arbitrary L1-valued maps is implemented.
claims.falsifier: Mismatch against the exact triple median oracle or violation of the 3024 cotype inequality on any rational stationary fixture generated by the script.
claims.next_gate: Independent implementation review, optimized rational benchmark, and comparison against MN26 after manuscript access.
